summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers and string-property indirection objects hiding URL and filename constants) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...`, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the bundled `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file (two-line minified body, rotated numeric/string array, hex-obfuscated top-level identifiers) with no readable source. The advertised purpose of the package is a design-tokens library, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time or to execute an obfuscated payload under it. Executing the payload via a freshly-downloaded alternate interpreter also evades Node-based install-time monitoring. This matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: install-time execution of opaque code delivered through a runtime whose purpose is unrelated to the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
